data.one_liner: Flexible request retry library for the Dio HTTP client package.
data.what_it_does: Adds an interceptor to the Dio HTTP client that automatically retries failed requests based on HTTP status codes. Supports dynamic delays between retries and customizable retry evaluation rules.
use_when: You need automatic retries for transient network failures or server errors using Dio.
You want to configure custom retry delays and retryable HTTP status codes.
avoid_when: You are not using the Dio package for HTTP requests.
You want a state management or storage solution.
strengths: Supports dynamic delay intervals between retries.
Customizable retryable status codes and evaluation logic.
weaknesses: Strictly tied to the Dio networking package.
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml and add RetryInterceptor to your Dio instance.
